title: Real Madrid stun Man City again, Fafa Picault chats being Messi's new teammate & USL makes shock announcement
text:

Subscribe to Cooligans The action of the Champions League of Christian Polanco and Alexis Guerreros, including the impressive return of Real Madrid against Man City. Children also react to a crazy Derby from Mersyside, an appropriate ending for the confrontation in Goodison Park.
Christian and Alexis then talk with Inter Miami striker, Fafa Picault, before his first season as a teammate of Lionel Messi in MLS.
Later, Christian and Alexis react the shocking announcement of USL that they will launch a first level football division in 2026 and what that can mean for the American football landscape.
